text: ワルの　ほうが　かっこいいぜ！

structure.en: the bad guy is the more

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one side out of two and says it is the more so. ワルの ほうが かっこいい = 'being bad is cooler'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end of a sentence is rough, boastful male speech. かっこいいぜ = 'it's cool, man!'
